chunks: He said: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh reported to me, saying: My father narrated to me, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Kulaib ibn Mu'awiyah al-Asadi, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, saying:

Verily, by Allah, you are indeed upon the religion of Allah and His angels. So help us in that through piety and striving. It is your duty to establish prayer and worship. It is your duty to remain pious.

key_terms.اجتهاد: Strenuous effort and striving in religious practice
key_terms.دين الله: The religion of Allah; the divinely ordained path
key_terms.ملائكته: His angels; indicating angelic endorsement of the Shia faith
key_terms.ورع: Piety, God-consciousness, scrupulous avoidance of sin

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the Shia being on the religion of Allah and His angels?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Amali of al-Mufid, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) addresses his followers with an emphatic oath, affirming that they follow the religion endorsed by Allah and His angels. He then exhorts them to support the cause of the Ahl al-Bayt through piety (wara') and diligent effort, commanding them to maintain regular prayer and worship, and above all to adhere to piety. This teaching was given in a context where the Shia community faced social and political pressure, and the Imam emphasized that spiritual discipline -- not merely sectarian identity -- validates their faith.
